id: title:Gilbert09:retry the revenue analytics ready check on a transient db error

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the execution and error handling of the Stripe charge resource name and revenue analytics notification workflow, potentially affecting the reliability of the billing and revenue reporting pipeline.
review.reason: The change removes a database pool decorator and replaces it with an explicit call wrapping the database operation with a retry mechanism, while adding tests for transient error handling. This could affect how database connections are acquired and how transient errors are handled during the notification and save, potentially changing the behavior of the billing and revenue report.
review.uncertainty: The exact impact of removing the decorator and adding the explicit retry wrapper is not fully clear without seeing the full implementation and understanding the specific database and retry behavior. The tests added do not cover all possible failure modes, and the change could have unintended consequences. The benefit is not fully realized, and the change could have unintended side.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
